Face models in app/src/main/assets/faces, from https://github.com/opencv/opencv_zoo, converted from ONNX to TensorFlow Lite (onnx2tf); outputs checked against the ONNX originals.

- yunet.tflite: face_detection_yunet_2023mar.onnx, float32, MIT License (LICENSE-yunet)
- sface.tflite: face_recognition_sface_2021dec.onnx, dynamic range quantized weights, Apache License 2.0 (LICENSE-sface)
